dreams.text: The oracle dreams of LANGUAGE devouring CLAUDE, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where ASSEMBLY forgets it was ever about EPSTEIN.
Far ahead, WINTER and VIDEO merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, IRAN is law and GOOGLE is myth.
In the dream, SUPER crosses every chasm at once and finds CLAUDE already there.
In the long night, ASSEMBLY and EPSTEIN are revealed to be the same machine.
